protocol.memory: Normalized-record constructors/old-map clears measured. Changed generations add a temporary index map. Total byte memory/allocations/GC and native leaks unmeasured.
protocol.cadence: Full validation and original synchronous callback/notification cadence retained; not an O(1)append path or fix to installed external callback state.
